# `modernize-managed-container`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: modernize · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `std.array_list.Managed`, `std.array_list.AlignedManaged`, and
`std.bit_set.DynamicManaged`, the allocator-storing compatibility containers.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Current Zig APIs make allocator dependencies explicit at allocating call sites
and the managed form is migration-only.

## When it fires

The rule reports without an edit when allocator threading cannot be proven.

Nested members such as `wrapper.std.array_list.Managed` and local bindings that
shadow `std` are skipped.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn make(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) std.array_list.Managed(u8) {
    return std.array_list.Managed(u8).init(gpa);
}
```
